message.content:
Here’s a mix of classic chills and modern scares you might enjoy:

| # | Title | Year | Why it’s worth watching |
|---|-------|------|--------------------------|
| 1 | **The Shining** (1980) | A psychological masterpiece with iconic imagery and an unforgettable score. |
| 2 | **Hereditary** (2018) | A slow‑burn dread that culminates in a truly shocking finale. |
| 3 | **Get Out** (2017) | Sharp social commentary wrapped in a suspenseful thriller. |
| 4 | **A Quiet Place** (2018) | Tension built around silence—perfect for a nerve‑wracking night. |
| 5 | **Midsommar** (2019) | A daylight horror that turns the genre on its head. |
| 6 | **It Follows** (2014) | An unsettling premise that keeps you on edge throughout. |
| 7 | **The Conjuring** (2013) | A well‑crafted haunted house story with plenty of jump‑scares. |
| 8 | **The Babadook** (2014) | Psychological terror that feels deeply personal. |
| 9 | **Suspiria** (1977) | A visually striking film that still feels fresh today. |
|10 | **The Cabin in the Woods** (2012) | A meta‑take on horror tropes that delivers both laughs and screams. |

Feel free to pick one or two depending on how intense you want your Friday night to be!
